title: Battle of Sedan
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sedan", at revision 1381666030, opens: "The Battle of Sedan, also known as the First Battle of Sedan, was fought during the Franco-Prussian War from 1 to 2 September 1870. Resulting in the capture of Emperor Napoleon III and over a hundred thousand troops, it effectively decided the war in favour of Prussia and its allies; however, fighting continued under a new French government." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q156681, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1870 battle during the Franco-Prussian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
